description: This is a PHP source file defining the Payment controller class for the OpenCart admin extension system. It manages listing, installation, and uninstallation of payment extensions within the admin interface.

classes.name: Payment
classes.description: Controller class for managing payment extensions in the OpenCart admin area, including listing available extensions, and handling their installation and uninstallation.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default method that outputs the list of payment extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a list of available and installed payment extensions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a payment extension, including permission checks and setup routines.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation of a payment extension, including permission checks.
